assumptions: Billion VND. Toy policy: assurance warranty is a cost provision; separately priced extended service warranty is a performance obligation recognized evenly over two years. All sales occur at January 1; no other contracts.

evidence.text: Bán thiết bị thu 500 tỷ; bảo hành đảm bảo chất lượng tiêu chuẩn đi kèm, không có giá bán riêng.
Bảo hành mở rộng thu riêng 40 tỷ cho hai năm dịch vụ; năm đầu đã thực hiện đủ.
Dự phòng chi phí bảo hành đảm bảo chất lượng là 15 tỷ; chưa chi tiền. Dịch vụ bảo hành mở rộng ghi nhận theo thời gian.
Không cung cấp chi phí thực hiện bảo hành mở rộng.

qas.question: How much total revenue is recognized in year one from the two transactions?
qas.answer: Equipment revenue is 500; year-one extended service revenue is 40/2=20. Total revenue=520 billion VND. The standard assurance warranty cost is not a separate revenue obligation in this case.

qas.question: Should the 15 assurance provision be treated as deferred service revenue?
qas.answer: No. It represents expected assurance warranty costs and is a provision under the stated policy. The deferred extended-warranty consideration is separate and relates to future services.

qas.question: Can we calculate the year-one profit from extended warranty services?
qas.answer: No. The recognized service revenue is 20, but the cost of providing those services is absent. The 15 provision relates to the assurance warranty, not the extended service.

assumptions: Billion VND. All line items are distinct, same annual scope. Operating income here includes net interest, net fee income and trading result. Cash realization of trading gains is not assumed.

evidence.text: Thu nhập lãi 760; chi phí lãi 420.
Thu phí 130; chi phí phí dịch vụ 40.
Lãi kinh doanh chứng khoán 55, gồm 15 đã thực hiện và 40 đánh giá lại chưa thực hiện.
Không có chi phí hoạt động, dự phòng tín dụng hoặc thuế trong trích đoạn.

qas.question: Determine operating income under the stated definition.
qas.answer: Net interest income=760−420=340; net fee income=130−40=90; trading result=55. Operating income=485 billion VND before the undisclosed expenses.

qas.question: Can we describe the entire trading result as realized trading cash income?
qas.answer: No. Forty of the 55 is explicitly unrealized. Even realized gains measure profit relative to carrying amount, not necessarily total cash sale proceeds.

qas.question: Can the disclosed operating income be used as the bank's profit after tax?
qas.answer: No. The disclosed subtotal excludes operating expenses, credit loss charges and taxes, so profit after tax is not determined.

assumptions: Tonnes CO2e. Gross reported emissions are not reduced by offsets. A separate voluntary net-emissions metric deducts retired qualifying credits. Purchased but unretired credits are excluded from that voluntary metric.

evidence.text: Phát thải gộp 2024: 100.000 tấn; 2025: 110.000 tấn CO2e, cùng ranh giới kiểm kê.
Năm 2025 mua 25.000 tín chỉ, đã hủy để bù trừ 15.000; 10.000 chưa hủy.
Chỉ tiêu phát thải ròng tự nguyện 2025 = phát thải gộp trừ tín chỉ đã hủy đủ điều kiện. Không điều chỉnh phát thải gộp.
Không có tín chỉ 2024, sản lượng hoặc xác nhận chất lượng tín chỉ ngoài giả định bài.

qas.question: Calculate the company's 2025 voluntary net-emissions metric.
qas.answer: 110,000−15,000=95,000 tonnes CO2e. The 10,000 purchased but unretired credits are not deducted, and gross emissions remain 110,000.

qas.question: Does the 95,000 figure show that gross emissions fell from 2024?
qas.answer: No. Gross emissions actually rose from 100,000 to 110,000, or 10%. The 95,000 metric incorporates retired offsets and is not comparable to gross emissions as if it were the same measure.

qas.question: Can we determine whether the company improved its emissions intensity per unit of production?
qas.answer: No. Production volumes are not supplied, so emissions intensity cannot be calculated. Neither the absolute gross nor voluntary net metric establishes unit-level efficiency.

assumptions: Billion VND. All figures refer to the same fictional company; the table labels govern the answer. The individual report is not consolidated. Parentheses denote negative values.

evidence.text:
|Chỉ tiêu|Quý IV/2025 hợp nhất|FY2025 hợp nhất|FY2024 hợp nhất|FY2025 riêng|
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
|Doanh thu thuần|360|1400|1250|1100|
|Lợi nhuận sau thuế|(-12)|75|100|90|
Không có thay đổi phạm vi hoặc hồi tố theo thuyết minh. Các cột quý IV và cả năm không được cộng do quý IV đã nằm trong cả năm.
Thông cáo chỉ nêu LNST công ty mẹ riêng năm 2025 là 90; không thay thế số hợp nhất.

qas.question: What was the consolidated net margin for the full FY2025?
qas.answer: Use consolidated full-year profit 75 and revenue 1,400. Net margin=75/1,400≈5.36%. The quarterly loss and standalone profit do not belong in this annual calculation.

qas.question: How much consolidated net profit was earned in the first nine months of FY2025?
qas.answer: Full-year profit 75 includes the fourth-quarter loss of −12. First-nine-month profit=75−(−12)=87 billion VND.

qas.question: Does standalone net profit of 90 versus consolidated 75 prove that subsidiaries collectively lost exactly 15?
qas.answer: No. The difference may include subsidiaries, intercompany eliminations and accounting adjustments. Standalone and consolidated profits are not an additive bridge without further disclosures.
